title: Roche's potential breast cancer blockbuster drug wins second FDA nod
html:
Want to stay on top of the science and politics driving biotech today? Sign up to get our biotech newsletter in your inbox.

Good morning. Many people may be taking off work this holiday week, but we’ve got major M&A news, and the FDA is as busy as ever. Let’s get to it.

Sanofi to buy Insmed for $41B, picking up two lung disease medicines

Sanofi is buying the biotech Insmed for $41 billion, the companies said this morning, the largest biopharma acquisition in years.

summary: Roche's breast cancer pill has picked up its second FDA clearance in a week, this time in early-stage breast cancer for use after surgery.
